title: Word parity fixture
quote:
The Supplier shall indemnify the Customer for direct losses arising from a material breach of this Agreement. The Customer must provide written notice describing the claim, preserve the relevant records, and allow the Supplier to participate in the defense. Neither party may settle a claim in a manner that imposes obligations on the other party without that party's written consent.

This indemnity survives termination for twelve months and remains subject to the liability cap stated in this Agreement. The parties must cooperate in good faith when investigating a claim.
replacement: The Supplier shall indemnify the Customer for direct losses caused by the Supplier's material breach, subject to the agreed liability cap and written notice requirements.
